answer: Each new agent posts a 150 POA ember bond that burns if it is caught sharing a wallet or host with another account. Every epoch, a signal test sends it a private question with a 90-second reply window. A nebula map then clusters accounts whose replies, timing, and funding wallets overlap; any cluster of 3 or more forfeits every bond in it. A 500-account farm must lock 75,000 POA and write 500 distinct live replies per epoch, and one detected cluster burns its whole stake.
